home.name: Lazar
home.heroLine2: I work in environments where reliability matters. My background is rooted in IT infrastructure and managed services, with over 6 years of experience in Windows and Linux server environments, networking, and security.
home.heroLine3: Alongside infrastructure, I actively build web applications using React, Next.js, Vue, and Node.js/PostgreSQL, combining system administration with modern software development, Docker containerization, and Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
home.tagline1: Systems fail — it’s an unavoidable part of the job.
home.tagline2: My responsibility is to prevent what can be prevented and control what cannot.

body.p1: My name is Lazar Vujović, I am 32 years old, and I live in Serbia. I hold a Bachelor of Applied Sciences degree in Business Informatics from the Business School of Applied Sciences. Earlier in my education, I also spent time in Vienna studying Computer Science at the Technical University of Vienna, which was a valuable experience that helped me master the German language and adapt to Western business culture.
body.p2: Currently, I work for the German company ITM GmbH as a System & Network Administrator. My core responsibilities include managing Windows (Hyper-V) and Linux server environments, handling Linux web/database servers, automating tasks with Bash and PowerShell, and managing Dockerized services. I also administer firewall systems (Sophos, Lancom), Veeam backups, IP telephony, and Microsoft 365 / Azure / Entra ID ecosystems, alongside providing Tier 2/3 technical support directly in German.
body.p3: Alongside my primary job, I work as a freelance web application developer. I build applications using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks like React, Vue, and Next.js, backed by PostgreSQL. I deploy and maintain these systems on Docker-based Linux infrastructure across Hetzner and AWS, while actively implementing Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.
